description: Rendering study: the guard's fight, drawn as real geometry beside a flat one.
notes: `kernel_guard` with one extra body, and the extra body is the control. The mesh guard and the flat guard carry identical tuning (`lab/enemies/mesh-guard.ts` spreads `GUARD` rather than copying it), stand the same distance from the king, and differ only in how they are drawn — so anything a viewer notices between them is the rendering.

Both at once and in one frame, because that is the question. A room holding only the mesh body would answer 'does this look good', which nobody needs a room for; a room holding both answers 'does this read as the same cast', which is the decision actually in front of the project.
Untimed, like the kernel it is derived from. A clock would make the room about pressure and this room is about pixels.
